items.title: Human-Agent-Society/reef
items.excerpt: Continual learning infra for self-improving agents
items.summary: Reef provides continual learning infrastructure for self-improving agents, enabling recursive agent development.
items.usefulness: Could support building agents that adapt behavior over time if the learning mechanism handles document context retention and governance constraints.
items.to_verify: What learning persistence mechanism is actually implemented, and does it preserve audit trails for governance compliance?

items.title: Player-YN/BrowserKitten
items.excerpt: Paw Work - selection-first web agent for Chrome: select on the live page, describe the outcome, take away an editable office file. BYOK, sandboxed, no server.
items.summary: BrowserKitten is a selection-first web agent for Chrome that converts user selections and descriptions into editable office files, running sandboxed without server or API key requirement.
items.usefulness: Could prototype document extraction and automation tools for Python by studying its local-first architecture and Chrome automation patterns.
items.to_verify: Whether the sandboxing model actually prevents access to sensitive data and how editable output accuracy compares to manual extraction.

items.title: 2akouwu/reverify
items.excerpt: Stop your AI from making things up — it proposes, deterministic tools decide, every claim checked against ground truth with evidence. Grounded facts and context survive resets. Reverse engineering is the proving ground. MCP server + CLI.
items.summary: Reverify stops AI hallucination by proposing claims, checking against ground truth with deterministic tools, and preserving grounded facts across resets; includes MCP server and CLI.
items.usefulness: If conditionally integrated, could help Python tools verify AI-generated document analysis claims against reference data before users trust them.
items.to_verify: How ground-truth checking performs on multi-document reasoning, and whether the evidence chain remains auditable for governance review.
